verdict.rationale: Sill's site and README both say touch and Apple Pencil drive the Mac. Taps become clicks, scrolls carry momentum, Apple Pencil acts as the pointer, there is an on-screen trackpad, and three-finger swipes and pinches map to Mac trackpad gestures. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and detail on drag, right-click and Pencil pressure or hover handling.
